description: CDC NWSS wastewater viral activity level (WVAL) for one US state or territory — same population-weighted national methodology as wastewater_national_trend, scoped to reporting sites within the state. Example: wastewater_state_trend({"state":"California","pathogen":"SARS-CoV-2"}).

pathogen.description: Pathogen: "SARS-CoV-2" (aliases: covid, covid-19), "Influenza A" (aliases: flu, influenza), or "RSV". Default SARS-CoV-2.

state.description: US state, DC, or territory name or postal abbreviation (e.g. "California" or "CA").

weeks.description: Trailing weeks of history to include (default 4, max 12).

name: wastewater_state_trend
